svg.title: A 40-step process

path.aria-label: Request received to Load the customer account (1)
Load the customer account (1) to Score the fraud risk (2)
Score the fraud risk (2) to Check 1 passed?
Check 1 passed? to Load the customer account (1): no
Check 1 passed? to Charge the card (4): yes
Charge the card (4) to Write the ledger entry (5)
Write the ledger entry (5) to Notify the warehouse (6)
Notify the warehouse (6) to Check 2 passed?
Check 2 passed? to Validate the request (10): no
Check 2 passed? to Send the receipt (8): yes
Send the receipt (8) to Update the order status (9)
Update the order status (9) to Validate the request (10)
Validate the request (10) to Check 3 passed?
Check 3 passed? to Update the order status (9): no
Check 3 passed? to Score the fraud risk (12): yes
Score the fraud risk (12) to Reserve the stock (13)
Reserve the stock (13) to Charge the card (14)
Charge the card (14) to Check 4 passed?
Check 4 passed? to Send the receipt (18): no
Check 4 passed? to Notify the warehouse (16): yes
Notify the warehouse (16) to Print the shipping label (17)
Print the shipping label (17) to Send the receipt (18)
Send the receipt (18) to Check 5 passed?
Check 5 passed? to Print the shipping label (17): no
Check 5 passed? to Validate the request (20): yes
Validate the request (20) to Load the customer account (21)
Load the customer account (21) to Score the fraud risk (22)
Score the fraud risk (22) to Check 6 passed?
Check 6 passed? to Notify the warehouse (26): no
Check 6 passed? to Charge the card (24): yes
Charge the card (24) to Write the ledger entry (25)
Write the ledger entry (25) to Notify the warehouse (26)
Notify the warehouse (26) to Check 7 passed?
Check 7 passed? to Write the ledger entry (25): no
Check 7 passed? to Send the receipt (28): yes
Send the receipt (28) to Update the order status (29)
Update the order status (29) to Validate the request (30)
Validate the request (30) to Check 8 passed?
Check 8 passed? to Charge the card (34): no
Check 8 passed? to Score the fraud risk (32): yes
Score the fraud risk (32) to Reserve the stock (33)
Reserve the stock (33) to Charge the card (34)
Charge the card (34) to Check 9 passed?
Check 9 passed? to Reserve the stock (33): no
Check 9 passed? to Notify the warehouse (36): yes
Notify the warehouse (36) to Print the shipping label (37)
Print the shipping label (37) to Send the receipt (38)
Send the receipt (38) to Done

svg.text: box = step, diamond = decision, rounded = start or end
